## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] `cd web && npm run check && npm run build` pass
- [ ] `scripts/smoke.sh` passes against a running API (for API changes)
- [ ] New source files start with the SPDX / copyright header
- [ ] Docs updated (README, docs/API.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) when behaviour changes
- [ ] No secret, password or personal data in the diff
